name: Apollos
overview: Apollos is a male figure identified as an Alexandrian Jew who was well-versed and powerful in the Scriptures. His background as an Alexandrian Jew highlights his connection to a prominent Jewish community known for learning. There are no additional personal notes or tribal affiliations recorded for him.
namesAndTitles: The name Apollos is a proper name mentioned in Acts 18:24. No specific meaning or divine origin of the name is provided in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Apollos beyond what is noted in his unique attribute as an Alexandrian Jew mighty in the Scriptures.
scriptureSignificance: Apollos is significant in the biblical narrative as a knowledgeable and eloquent teacher of Scripture, demonstrating a deep understanding of the Jewish Scriptures. His role as an Alexandrian Jew skilled in the Scriptures suggests he was instrumental in instructing and strengthening early Christian believers. His presence in the narrative underscores the importance of scriptural knowledge and teaching in the growth of the early church.
